properties.description:
The minor in which a proof records without fighting the duplicate guard and reads back whole. It carries proof trial rung 2's fixes:
- a near-match across types, or within a line of reasoning, is a note, not a refusal; reasoning_report keeps each claim's words and pages (#767);
- a claim's step count counts each step once, and the whole-design reasoning walk reaches refuted claims (#768).

Pinned here: rel:v0870, the increment's 10 ChangeEvents (found by diffing ids against the v0.86.0 tag's committed copy), and the cut's 8 drift acceptances. Two of the 10, from #768 (chg:a-claim-counts-each-step-under-it-once-2026-10-18 and chg:the-whole-reasoning-walk-reaches-refuted-claims-2026-10-18), are ALSO pinned to epoch:v0860-cut although they post-date that tag. The cut removed those two pins and then put them back, because the design copy refuses a removal in flight (fact:the-design-copy-is-refused-when-the-live-design-removed-an-edge-the-committed-copy-holds-2026-10-13) and its workaround was refused in this session; removing them is left to Anthony.
properties.name: v0.87.0 release cut (2026-10-18)
